subject.title: Moulton Niguel Water District Board (Short Term)

text: Water Policy Advisor

I started my public service on my neighborhood community services district, a special district just like the Moulton Niguel Water District. I went on to incorporate the City of Laguna Niguel, served as its first mayor, and led the fight against the El Toro Airport.
As an Orange County Supervisor, California State Assemblywoman, and California State Senator, I represented every community within Moulton Niguel Water District's service area.

I'm proud of my record as a taxfighter:
Defended Proposition 13 and Proposition 218, your right to challenge water rates
Received the Howard Jarvis Taxpayers Association’s highest rating

I've never stopped serving the community I love: in addition to being the President of the Laguna Niguel Historical Society, I am a Director for the Howard Jarvis Taxpayers Association, protecting taxpayers throughout California.
Now, I am focused on water. Whether you’re a renter or homeowner, a young family or a retiree, we all need safe, reliable water at a price we can afford.
As your Moulton Niguel Water District director, water quality and safety will always be my first priority.

I will invest in the pipes, pumps, and reservoirs that keep water flowing through drought and emergencies, at the lowest responsible cost, with a full public accounting of how our money is being spent.
I would be honored to receive your vote. Please visit votepatbates.com.

text: Business Owner/Consultant

For 14 years, I have proudly called Laguna Niguel home and have actively served our community through volunteer leadership with the City and the Orange County Sheriff’s Department. Public service, to me, is about giving back—not politics. I am independent, have no political agenda, and seek no higher office.

I previously served ten years as an elected Director of the South Coast Water District, including three terms as Board President. During my tenure, I focused on long-range planning, fiscal responsibility, and major infrastructure projects requiring years of engineering, financing, and construction.

As a Director of the Moulton Niguel Water District, I will put that experience to work for you. My priorities are straightforward: provide excellent, reliable service while keeping rates in check; protect the quality and reliability of our water supply; strengthen regional cooperation to ensure adequate water during droughts and emergencies; and safeguard our critical infrastructure against cyberattacks and physical threats.

Reliable water is essential to our homes, businesses, and quality of life. I have the experience, judgment, and proven record to help keep our District financially strong, secure, and prepared for the future.
I respectfully ask for your vote.
Joel Bishop

text: Retired Cybersecurity Professional
I am running for the Moulton Niguel Water District Board of Directors because I believe in fiscal responsibility, transparent decision-making, and reliable public infrastructure.

For more than 25 years, I have worked in cyber operations, cybersecurity, and digital forensics, managing, leading, and mentoring teams responsible for protecting critical systems and delivering complex projects. As water infrastructure becomes increasingly connected, safeguarding critical systems from cyber threats is an important part of protecting reliable public services.
I hold a Bachelor’s degree from the University of California, Irvine and a Master’s degree in Cybersecurity from Fordham University in New York.
Over the past 10 years, I have also managed residential real estate, gaining practical experience in budgeting, long-term planning, and responsible stewardship.

If elected, I will work to ensure reliable, affordable water service today while planning responsibly for the District’s long-term water reliability and infrastructure needs. I will focus on protecting taxpayer resources, promoting transparency, strengthening resilience, and helping ensure our water system remains dependable for future generations.
I would be honored to earn your support.
